messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] signal detection
parts:
Hi.

On Sat, Sep 17, 2011 at 5:37 AM, marco <hards...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Dear Madam or Sir
>  Is there any way in aroma.affymetrix for measuring how well a gene
> is detected for human exon 1.0 ST array and human Gene 1.0 ST array? I
> mean method with same function as paCalls() in package oligo.

Unfortunately, there are no corresponding implementations for
"detection above background" (DABG) or 'PSDABG' as in oligo.

/Henrik

For the record, DAGB has been discussed earlier in the following thread:

* 'exon array next steps', 2011-02-03;
https://groups.google.com/d/topic/aroma-affymetrix/uxZXt_exjeQ/discussion
* 'FIRMAGene with masked CEL files', 2009-11-16;
https://groups.google.com/d/topic/aroma-affymetrix/c6NtSmbbRhs/discussion
